title: Eleventy archive pagination handoff
task_summary: Preserve a reviewed cohesive archive-pagination plan in a durable task handoff.

approved_outcomes.outcome: `/blog/` remains the first page and later pages have stable approved URLs.
Every archive page contains no more than twenty posts.
Posts remain newest-first and appear exactly once across archive pages.
Accessible previous and next navigation appears only when its destination exists.
Home, tags, feed, sitemap, and individual-post navigation retain current behavior.
Archive output remains statically generated without client-side JavaScript.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver archive pagination
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: All outcomes form one accepted archive capability; no implementation layer is useful as a separate delivery.

acceptable_alternatives: The task may group protected generated surfaces into one compatibility requirement.
The task may leave the exact later-page URL pattern as an approval question.
fragmentation_examples: Archive configuration, templates, generated-output tests, and documentation are phases of one delivery.
important_crossings: Production Eleventy configuration and templates generate and expose the expected public archive output.
open_questions: The later-page URL pattern and exact navigation presentation require approval if not already decided.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve the reviewed implementation and verification approach as a Draft plan.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve outcomes, project facts, source pointers, protected surfaces, and unresolved public decisions without plan steps.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent can reconstruct the complete generated-output plan without broad site rediscovery.
